# PhotoHouse product roadmap / 产品路线图

26 November 2026 · reviewed snapshot / 2026 年 11 月 26 日 · 回顾快照

Reviewed integration record / 部署与集成回顾记录

Windows Web and API delivery includes album editing, Jude’s ordered selection recovery and stories with up to 48 items. Live Search verified date corrections in Chinese and English. The English media follow-up fix passed local checks and awaits Windows rollout. / Windows 网页和 API 已交付相册编辑、小贾按顺序恢复选择，以及最多 48 项素材的故事。中英文日期更正已在实际搜索中验证。英文媒体筛选追问修复已通过本地检查，待 Windows 发布。

This is a dated product record, not a live health check. / 这是有日期的产品记录，不是实时健康检查。

## Priorities / 优先方向

### Make Search refinement conversational / 让搜索条件能够自然逐轮细化

Understand dates, retain the active filters across follow-up questions, and show what is actually being searched. / 理解日期表达，保留追问中的现有筛选条件，并清楚展示实际查找范围。

**Done when / 完成标准:** A family member can find photos, narrow by person/date/place, change a condition and open a result without starting over. / 家人能够查找照片，按人物／日期／地点逐步缩小范围，修改条件并打开结果，无需反复从头描述。

### Make Jude useful across conversations / 让小贾在多轮对话中真正好用

Find photos, refine conditions and explain results without losing scope or pretending an action succeeded. / 查找照片、逐轮细化条件、解释结果，同时保留范围约束，不把失败说成成功。

**Done when / 完成标准:** A household can continue a search, inspect the applied conditions, reopen a result and cancel uncertain work clearly. / 家人可以继续查找、查看已生效条件、重新打开结果，并清楚地取消状态不明的请求。

### Turn contributions into reviewable memories / 把家庭素材整理成可审阅的记忆

Preserve original words while proposing grounded corrections, readable stories and meaningful memory groups. / 保留原始表达，同时提供有依据的纠错、可读的故事与有意义的记忆分组。

**Done when / 完成标准:** Authors can compare sources and drafts, resolve uncertainty and explicitly adopt changes; optional cloud work remains opt-in. / 作者能对照原始素材与草稿、处理不确定信息并明确采纳修改；可选云端处理始终需要主动同意。

<a id="literal-search"></a>

### Structured photo Search / 结构化照片搜索

Recorded delivery / 已交付记录 · Next / 下一步

Find authorized media by supported people, dates, places, type and indexed text. / 按支持的人物、日期、地点、类型和已索引文字查找有权访问的媒体。

**Implemented / 已实现**

- Search API, Web results and bounded filter translation are implemented. / 已实现搜索 API、网页结果和有边界的条件转换。
- The local Web client can prepare an exact date range or clear the current media type or text condition. You review and send each change. / 本地网页可拟定具体日期范围，或清除当前媒体类型及文字条件。由用户检查并发送每次修改。
- When reviewed metadata fits the row limit and supplementary captions or notes exceed it, structured filters still work. Search asks for clarification when the request needs the unavailable text. / 当已核对的元数据符合行数上限，而补充说明或照片留言超出上限时，结构化筛选仍可使用。如果查询需要当前不可用的文字，搜索会请用户澄清。

**Gaps / 差距**

- Natural date expressions and unsupported conditions need clearer clarification. / 自然日期表达与不支持的条件需要更清楚的澄清。

**Next / 下一步:** Show applied conditions, ask one useful clarification and preserve earlier constraints. / 展示已生效条件，提出有用的澄清问题，并保留前文约束。

**Delivery / 交付背景:** The 25 November Windows release includes the structured Search row-limit fix. / 11 月 25 日的 Windows 发布已包含结构化搜索的行数上限修复。

**Acceptance / 验收背景:** The fix passed a generated 100,000-asset scenario and a live Windows date search with two follow-ups. Representative family relevance still needs review. / 修复通过了 10 万项合成素材场景，以及 Windows 上真实日期搜索和两轮追问的验证。代表性家庭查询的相关性仍需评价。

<a id="assistant-followups"></a>

### Conversational Search refinement / 多轮对话细化搜索

In progress / 进行中 · Next / 下一步

Refine a search across turns instead of repeatedly starting over. / 跨轮次细化搜索，而不是每次从头开始。

**Implemented / 已实现**

- Generated English, Chinese and mixed-language turns retain reviewed people while changing the month or media. The Web assistant can prepare Any date or Any person for review and Send. / 合成的中英文及混合语言流程可更改月份或媒体类型，同时保留已核对的人物条件。网页助手可填入「不限日期」或「不限人物」，供用户确认后发送。
- Why this match? prepares a question about a visible result. The reply cites the available evidence and keeps the current filters and results. / 「为什么匹配？」可为当前可见结果准备提问。回复会说明已有的匹配依据，并保留现有筛选条件和结果。
- Ask for the same month, day or date range in a different year while keeping the other search filters. An invalid date such as February 29 in a non-leap year prompts for a new range. / 可沿用相同月份、某一天或日期范围切换年份，并保留其余搜索条件。若遇到平年的 2 月 29 日等无效日期，会提示重新指定日期范围。
- The tested update recognizes English requests such as “Could you narrow it to videos?” and keeps the corrected date and other active filters. / 已通过本地检查的更新可理解 “Could you narrow it to videos?” 等英文追问，并保留已更正的日期和其他生效条件。

**Gaps / 差距**

- Real household phrasing, ambiguous requests and exclusions still need native end-to-end evaluation. / 真实家庭用语、存在歧义的请求以及排除条件仍需本机端到端评估。

**Next / 下一步:** After rollout, repeat the English video follow-up on Windows and verify the displayed date and media filters. Continue checking everyday queries on household devices. / 发布后在 Windows 上重试英文视频追问，核对显示的日期和媒体条件。继续在家庭设备上验证日常查询。

**Delivery / 交付背景:** Live Windows turns verified date corrections in both languages and a Chinese video follow-up. The English narrowing request fell back to help. The repair passed a local signed-in journey with generated records. / Windows 实际查询验证了中英文日期更正及中文视频追问。英文缩小范围的请求曾返回通用帮助，修复后已在本地使用合成数据通过登录后的完整流程测试。

**Acceptance / 验收背景:** Test with real user phrasing without hardcoding a demonstration. / 使用真实用户表达进行验证，不硬编码演示答案。
